original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`, when the parsed config is inspected, then `config.autoRoute.enabled === false`.
refined: NaxConfigSchema.parse({}) returns an object with config.autoRoute.enabled === false (boolean literal false, not undefined, null, or string 'false')

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`, when the parsed config is inspected, then `config.autoRoute.minSamples === 8`.
refined: NaxConfigSchema.parse({}) returns an object with config.autoRoute.minSamples === 8 (number 8)

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`, when the parsed config is inspected, then `config.autoRoute.upgrade.escalationRate === 0.3` and `config.autoRoute.upgrade.mismatchRate === 0.25`.
refined: NaxConfigSchema.parse({}) returns an object where config.autoRoute.upgrade.escalationRate === 0.3 AND config.autoRoute.upgrade.mismatchRate === 0.25

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`, when the parsed config is inspected, then `config.autoRoute.downgrade.firstPassRate === 0.9` and `config.autoRoute.downgrade.escalationRate === 0.05`.
refined: NaxConfigSchema.parse({}) returns an object where config.autoRoute.downgrade.firstPassRate === 0.9 AND config.autoRoute.downgrade.escalationRate === 0.05

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({ autoRoute: { minSamples: 20 } })`, when the parsed config is inspected, then `autoRoute.minSamples === 20` and `autoRoute.enabled === false`.
refined: NaxConfigSchema.parse({ autoRoute: { minSamples: 20 } }) returns an object where config.autoRoute.minSamples === 20 AND config.autoRoute.enabled === false (partial override of minSamples preserves enabled default)

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.safeParse({ autoRoute: { enabled: "yes" } })`, when the parse result is inspected, then `success === false`.
refined: NaxConfigSchema.safeParse({ autoRoute: { enabled: 'yes' } }) returns { success: false } (type error: enabled must be boolean, not string)

original: Given a `RunMetrics[]` containing 10 stories of `complexity` `"simple"`, 4 of which have `attempts > 1`, when `computeBandStats` runs, then it returns a `BandStat` for `"simple"` with `sampleCount === 10` and `escalationRate === 0.4`.
refined: When `computeBandStats(runs, mapping)` is called with `runs` containing exactly 10 RunMetrics objects where each has `complexity === "simple"` and exactly 4 have `attempts > 1`, then the returned array contains exactly one BandStat with `band === "simple"`, `sampleCount === 10`, and `escalationRate === 0.4`.

original: Given a `RunMetrics[]` where 9 of 10 `"simple"` stories have `firstPassSuccess === true`, when `computeBandStats` runs, then the returned `BandStat` for `"simple"` has `firstPassRate === 0.9`.
refined: When `computeBandStats(runs, mapping)` is called with `runs` containing exactly 10 RunMetrics objects where each has `complexity === "simple"` and exactly 9 have `firstPassSuccess === true`, then the returned array contains exactly one BandStat with `band === "simple"` and `firstPassRate === 0.9`.

original: Given a mapping of `simple -> "fast"` and a `RunMetrics[]` where 3 of 10 `"simple"` stories have `finalTier === "balanced"`, when `computeBandStats` runs, then the returned `BandStat` for `"simple"` has `mismatchRate === 0.3`.
refined: When `computeBandStats(runs, mapping)` is called with `mapping` where `mapping.simple === "fast"` and `runs` containing exactly 10 RunMetrics objects where each has `complexity === "simple"` and exactly 3 have `finalTier === "balanced"`, then the returned array contains exactly one BandStat with `band === "simple"` and `mismatchRate === 0.3`.

original: Given history that contains only some complexity values, when `computeBandStats` runs, then it returns exactly one `BandStat` per distinct `complexity` value present in history and none for complexities absent from it.
refined: When `computeBandStats(runs, mapping)` is called with `runs` containing RunMetrics objects with distinct complexity values `[A, B, C]`, then the returned array has exactly 3 BandStats with bands equal to `A`, `B`, and `C` respectively, and no other BandStats.

original: Given an empty `RunMetrics[]`, when `computeBandStats` runs, then it returns an empty `BandStat[]`.
refined: When `computeBandStats([], mapping)` is called with an empty `runs` array, then the returned array has length `0`.

original: Given a `BandStat` with `escalationRate === 0.4` and `mismatchRate === 0.3` against a `simple -> "fast"` mapping, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it returns a `TierAdjustment` with `band === "simple"`, `from === "fast"`, `to === "balanced"`, and `direction === "upgrade"`.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` contains exactly one object where `band === "simple"` AND `from === "fast"` AND `to === "balanced"` AND `direction === "upgrade"`. Assert `result.skipped` is empty and `result.hints` is empty.

original: Given a `complex -> "powerful"` `BandStat` with `firstPassRate === 0.95`, `escalationRate === 0.02`, and observed `finalTier`s all at or below `"balanced"`, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it returns a `TierAdjustment` with `to === "balanced"` and `direction === "downgrade"`.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` contains exactly one object where `band === "complex"` AND `from === "powerful"` AND `to === "balanced"` AND `direction === "downgrade"`. Assert `result.skipped` is empty.

original: Given a `BandStat` whose `sampleCount` is below `thresholds.minSamples`, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it returns no adjustment for that band and lists it under `skipped` with its `sampleCount` and the `minSamples` used.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` does not contain an entry for the low-sample band. Assert `result.skipped` contains one object where `band === "<bandName>"` AND `sampleCount === <actualCount>` AND `minSamples === <thresholdValue>`. Assert `result.hints` is empty.

original: Given a band already mapped to `"fast"` that otherwise meets the downgrade criteria, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it returns no downgrade for that band.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` contains no entry where `direction === "downgrade"` AND `band === "<bandName>"`. Assert `result.skipped` is empty for that band.

original: Given a band already mapped to `"powerful"` that otherwise meets the upgrade criteria, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it returns no upgrade for that band.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` contains no entry where `direction === "upgrade"` AND `band === "<bandName>"`. Assert `result.skipped` is empty for that band.

original: Given a `simple -> "fast"` `BandStat` with `escalationRate === 0.9` and `mismatchRate === 0.9`, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it proposes `to === "balanced"` and not `"powerful"`.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` contains exactly one object where `band === "simple"` AND `from === "fast"` AND `to === "balanced"`. Assert no adjustment exists with `to === "powerful"`. Assert `result.adjustments.length === 1`.

original: Given a `BandStat` whose `escalationRate === 0.15` and whose `firstPassRate === 0.7`, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it returns no adjustment for that band.
refined: Assert `result.adjustments` is empty. Assert `result.skipped` is empty. Assert `result.hints` is empty.

original: Given a large-sample, high-mismatch `BandStat`, when `proposeAdjustments` runs, then it emits a `KeywordHint` whose `message` references `classify.ts` and the emitted hint object exposes no `from` or `to` tier field.
refined: Assert `result.hints` contains at least one object where `message` includes the substring `"classify.ts"`. Assert no object in `result.hints` has a property `from` or `to`. Assert `result.hints[0]` is of type `KeywordHint` (has `message` and `band` properties but no `from`/`to`).

original: Given `_deps.loadRunMetrics` returning a fixture `RunMetrics[]` that yields a threshold-breaching `"simple"` band, when the calibrate action runs, then the proposal `adjustments` include one with `band === "simple"`, `from === "fast"`, and `to === "balanced"`.
refined: Given `_deps.loadRunMetrics` is stubbed to return an array containing a `RunMetrics` object whose `complexity` is 0.2 (below the `simple` band upper threshold of 0.3) and `actualTier` is `"fast"` while the cost-sample average for the `simple` band exceeds the `fast` tier's cost ceiling, when `calibrate()` is called, then the returned `proposal.adjustments` array has length >= 1 and includes an object where `band === "simple"`, `from === "fast"`, and `to === "balanced"`.

original: Given `--json` mode, when the calibrate action runs, then it emits a JSON object exposing `adjustments`, `keywordHints`, and `skipped` arrays.
refined: Given the CLI is invoked with `--json` flag, when `parseArgs(['--json'])` is applied and `calibrate()` is called, then `stdout` receives a single line that is valid JSON containing top-level keys `"adjustments"`, `"keywordHints"`, and `"skipped"`, each value being an array. The three arrays are serializable via `JSON.parse` and `adjustments` entries contain `band`, `from`, `to` fields; `skipped` entries contain `band` and `reason` fields.

original: Given no `--apply` flag, when the calibrate action runs, then it does not invoke `_deps.writeConfig`.
refined: Given `_deps.writeConfig` is a jest mock/spy, when the CLI is invoked with no `--apply` argument (i.e., `parseArgs([])`) and `calibrate()` completes successfully, then `writeConfig` is never called (verified via `expect(writeConfig).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` or equivalent mock assertion).

original: Given `--apply` and at least one adjustment, when the calibrate action runs, then it invokes `_deps.writeConfig` once with a config whose `autoMode.complexityRouting` equals the prior mapping with only the proposed bands' tiers replaced and all other bands preserved.
refined: Given `_deps.writeConfig` is a jest mock/spy, when the CLI is invoked with `--apply` (i.e., `parseArgs(['--apply'])`) and `calibrate()` produces at least one adjustment, then `writeConfig` is called exactly once. The config object passed to `writeConfig` has an `autoMode.complexityRouting` property that: (a) contains all original bands (e.g., `simple`, `medium`, `complex`, `reasoning`) from the input config, (b) has the tier value replaced only for bands present in `proposal.adjustments`, and (c) preserves all unchanged bands with their original tier values exactly.

original: Given `--apply` and zero adjustments, when the calibrate action runs, then it does not invoke `_deps.writeConfig`.
refined: Given `_deps.writeConfig` is a jest mock/spy and `_deps.loadRunMetrics` returns a `RunMetrics[]` where no band exceeds its tier's cost ceiling (yielding zero adjustments), when the CLI is invoked with `--apply` (i.e., `parseArgs(['--apply'])`) and `calibrate()` runs to completion, then `writeConfig` is never called (verified via `expect(writeConfig).not.toHaveBeenCalled()`) and the process exits with code 0.

original: Given `--min-samples 20` and a band with `sampleCount === 10`, when the calibrate action runs, then that band is reported under `skipped`.
refined: Given `_deps.loadRunMetrics` returns bands where a specific band (e.g., `"medium"`) has `sampleCount === 10`, when the CLI is invoked with `--min-samples 20` (i.e., `parseArgs(['--min-samples', '20'])`) and `calibrate()` runs, then the `proposal.skipped` array includes an entry with `band === "medium"` and `reason` containing the string `"min-samples"` or `"20"`. The same band is absent from `proposal.adjustments`.

original: Given `_deps.loadRunMetrics` returns an empty array, when the calibrate action runs, then it reports insufficient history, does not invoke `_deps.writeConfig`, and completes without throwing.
refined: Given `_deps.loadRunMetrics` resolves to `[]`, when `calibrate()` is called (with or without `--apply`), then: (a) the returned result or stderr output contains a message indicating insufficient history or zero samples, (b) `_deps.writeConfig` is never called, and (c) the function resolves without throwing an `Error` (i.e., does not reject/throw). The process exits with code 0.

original: Given `ctx.config.autoRoute.enabled === false`, when `autoRoutePlugin.shouldRun` runs, then it returns `false`.
refined: Call `autoRoutePlugin.shouldRun({ config: { autoRoute: { enabled: false } }, ... })`. Assert the returned `Promise<boolean>` resolves to `false`.

original: Given injected `_deps.loadRunMetrics` history in which no band reaches `minSamples`, when `autoRoutePlugin.shouldRun` runs, then it returns `false`.
refined: Call `autoRoutePlugin.shouldRun(context)` where `_deps.loadRunMetrics` returns an array of bands each with `sampleCount < minSamples`. Assert the returned `Promise<boolean>` resolves to `false`.

original: Given the plugin is enabled and the injected history yields at least one adjustment, when `autoRoutePlugin.shouldRun` runs, then it returns `true`.
refined: Call `autoRoutePlugin.shouldRun(context)` where `config.autoRoute.enabled === true` and `_deps.loadRunMetrics` returns band data where `computeAdjustments()` produces a non-empty array. Assert the returned `Promise<boolean>` resolves to `true`.

original: Given fixture history that produces an adjustment, when `autoRoutePlugin.execute` runs, then it invokes `_deps.writeFile` exactly once with a path ending in `routing-proposal.json` whose parsed JSON `adjustments` contain that computed adjustment.
refined: Call `autoRoutePlugin.execute(context)` with `_deps.loadRunMetrics` fixture that produces a known adjustment `A`. Assert `_deps.writeFile` was called exactly once, with `path.endsWith('routing-proposal.json') === true`, and `JSON.parse(writtenContent).adjustments` is an array containing `A`.

original: Given the plugin happy path, when `autoRoutePlugin.execute` runs, then the single `_deps.writeFile` call targets the `routing-proposal.json` path and no `autoMode.complexityRouting` write occurs.
refined: Call `autoRoutePlugin.execute(context)` on the happy path. Assert `_deps.writeFile` was called exactly once with a path containing `'routing-proposal.json'`. Assert `_deps.writeFile` was never called with a path containing `'complexityRouting'` or `'autoMode'`.

original: Given `_deps.writeFile` rejects, when `autoRoutePlugin.execute` runs, then it returns `{ success: true }`, logs the failure via `ctx.logger`, and does not throw.
refined: Call `autoRoutePlugin.execute(context)` where `_deps.writeFile` is a function that returns `Promise.reject(new Error('write failed'))`. Assert the returned `Promise<PostRunActionResult>` resolves to `{ success: true }`. Assert `ctx.logger` (a `PluginLogger` stub) received a call with `.level === 'error'`. Assert the `execute` call did not throw.

original: Given `loadPlugins()` runs with `"nax-auto-route"` not in the disabled set, when `getPostRunActions()` is called on the returned registry, then it includes an action named `"nax-auto-route"`.
refined: Call `loadPlugins({ disabledPlugins: [] })`. Call `getPostRunActions()` on the returned registry. Assert the resulting array contains an element where `.name === 'nax-auto-route'` and the element is an object implementing `IPostRunAction`.
